comparison.objective: Mount a filled cup on a spindle mixer so its switch engages without spilling, not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tips and threads a heavy cup around an agitator into a narrow guide and rest while controlling spill risk.
comparison.success_condition: Cup seated on run step, spindle inside, switch pin lifted, upright, released and still, with no excessive tip versus two safe impacts.
comparison.reason: Constrained vessel mounting and spill avoidance are materially different.
